Implemented:
- Native Java / Views consumer interface based on the approved red/white design.
- Presets and Album destinations, light/dark color roles and bounded wide layouts.
- Multiple local NCP files, exact-byte persistence, content deduplication and legacy migration.
- User-associated real sample images; clear missing-image states.
- Configurable HTTPS online manifest, integrity-checked NCP and real preview downloads.
- No default service URL, built-in curated presets or bundled sample photos.
- Existing limited NCP compatibility adapter and USB backend preserved.
- Current slot inspection, frozen confirmation inputs, one registration and exact readback.
- Pending-operation journal, read-only recovery and atomic report readback checks.
- Old laboratory tools isolated in the non-exported Advanced Diagnostics activity.
- Original, read-only standard PTP/IP client, JPEG paging/thumbnails and streaming download.
- Single/multiple download tasks, actual progress and partial/cancelled/uncertain results.
- Offline app-local photos and optional Storage Access Framework save-as.
- Connection guide with collapsed address settings and current Wi-Fi gateway suggestion.

These are host/synthetic protocol and persistence checks, not physical camera tests.
UI-only revisions followed the suite runs; all final Android sources were compiled and
packaged with aapt2, javac and D8. Final APK signature, package, permissions and archive
contents were verified after the final build. Test commands use local tooling paths.

Source review and revisions covered pending-write recovery, diagnostic-entry guards,
atomic report verification, immutable confirmation inputs, callback navigation,
save-as lifecycle state, download/disconnect accounting and Wi-Fi-switch addressing.
Static palette contrast checks pass for the documented main text/button roles.
This is source/value review, not an Android visual/accessibility runtime test.

Physical verification and scope limits:
- User requested APK first and is not currently connecting the phone.
- No ADB device was available. No functional emulator was available.
- This APK was not installed or launched on a physical phone during this build.
- No actual UI screenshots, rotation/font-scale/night-mode checks or SAF runtime test.
- Existing Z6II copy/import success is user-reported prior feedback, not a new test.
- Standard PTP/IP wireless has not been tested with the user's Z6II.
- Nikon proprietary pairing/authentication is not implemented; compatibility may fail.
- JPEG only; no RAW/video or size conversion support.
- No real online endpoint/assets are available; network checks used synthetic fixtures.
- App-local downloaded photos are removed on uninstall; save-as allows retained copies.
- Registration/readback does not prove native-import or photographic-effect equivalence.
- Other camera models and iOS are outside this APK's validated scope.
